recommendations.recommendation: Serve your parents with reverence and love; filial piety is the root of all virtue.
recommendations.rationale: Filial conduct is the foundation from which good order in family and society grows.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Do not harm the body you received from your parents; keep it whole and healthy.
recommendations.rationale: The body is a gift from one's parents, so injuring it dishonors them.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Harming or neglecting one's own body.

recommendations.recommendation: Establish a good name through virtuous conduct, so that your parents are honored.
recommendations.rationale: A worthy life reflects honor on one's parents and ancestors.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Conduct that brings shame to one's family.

recommendations.recommendation: Serve your ruler loyally, extending filial duty into public service.
recommendations.rationale: Loyalty to the ruler follows naturally from filial devotion.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Follow the rites and ritual proprieties to govern conduct and keep harmony.
recommendations.rationale: Ritual forms guide behavior and maintain social order.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Disorderly conduct that ignores proper forms.

recommendations.recommendation: Honor your deceased parents through proper mourning and sacrifice.
recommendations.rationale: Continuing to honor the dead expresses unbroken filial feeling.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
